DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 植え込みについて何かご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: May tanong ba tungkol sa mga tanim?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 赤い実があるので、料理に使う実だと思いました。少し摘んで持ち帰れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 植え込みの実を食用と思い採取可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: May pulang bunga kaya akala ko pangluto. Puwede bang mamitas nang kaunti at iuwi?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing inakalang pagkain ang bunga at itanong ang pagpitas. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見た目だけで食べられるか判断しないでください。ここは採取用の植え込みでもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Huwag husgahang nakakain mula sa hitsura lang. Hindi rin ito tanim para anihin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ摘んでいません。名前が分からない物を味見して確かめることもしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未採取で味見による判断もしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi pa ako pumitas. Hindi rin ako titikim ng hindi kilala para tiyakin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi pumitas at hindi huhusga sa pagtikim. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。観察はできますが、枝や実を取らずにご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Opo. Maaaring obserbahan, pero huwag kumuha ng sanga o bunga.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子どもが興味を持っています。触らせず、離れた所から写真を撮るだけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子どもを触らせず観察だけにする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Interesado ang anak ko. Hindi ko ipapahawak; litrato lang mula sa malayo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag ipahawak sa bata, pagmamasid lang. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 植物について調べる場合も、写真だけで食用と決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kahit magsaliksik ng halaman, huwag isiping pagkain mula sa litrato lang.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。料理用は売場で食品として販売された物を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真だけで食用と決めず食品売場で選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Para sa pagluto, pipili ako ng ibinebenta bilang pagkain sa tindahan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi batay sa litrato ang pagiging pagkain at pipili sa food section. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにしてください。公園の植物はそのまま残しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Gawin iyon. Iwanang ganoon ang halaman ng parke.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。実を取らず、子どもにも持ち帰るための物ではないと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 採取せず子どもへ用途の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat. Hindi pipitas, at ipapaliwanag kong hindi ito para iuwi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag mamitas at ipaliwanag ang magkaibang gamit sa bata. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。観察のあとは通路へ戻り、公園の案内に従ってお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Pagkatapos tumingin, bumalik sa daan at sundin ang gabay ng parke.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車の時刻をお調べですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人から十時と聞いたので、十時にここを出る列車を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十時を発車時刻と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Sabi ng kaibigan alas-diyes, kaya naghahanap ng aalis dito alas-diyes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na inakalang oras ng alis ang alas-diyes. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メッセージは発車時刻ですか。それとも目的地で会う時刻でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Oras ba ng alis ang mensahe o oras ng pagkikita sa destinasyon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「十時に港駅で会おう」とあります。ここを出る時刻ではありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の文面から待ち合わせの到着時刻だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nakasulat magkita sa Port Station alas-diyes. Hindi pala oras ng alis dito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itama mula sa mensahe na oras ng dating para magkita. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では港駅へ十時に着く便を調べる必要があります。現在の時刻から確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kailangan ng darating sa Port Station alas-diyes. Tingnan mula sa oras ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。十時着が間に合わない場合は、友人に遅れると伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着に間に合う便の有無を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. Kung hindi aabot alas-diyes, sasabihin kong mahuhuli.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin kung may biyaheng aabot sa dating. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場面では十時までに着く便はもうありません。次の便の到着予定をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sa sitwasyong ito wala nang aabot bago alas-diyes. Sasabihin ang inaasahang dating ng kasunod.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。出発時刻だけでなく到着予定を聞き、友人の返事も確認してから券を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着予定を聞き友人の返事まで購入を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakiusap. Itatanong ko ang dating, hindi alis lang, at hihintayin sagot ng kaibigan bago bumili.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang dating at maghintay ng sagot bago bumili. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の便は十時半着の予定です。実際の運行状況も表示で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ang susunod ay inaasahang alas-diyes y medya. Tingnan din ang totoong takbo sa display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人が十時半に変更できると言いました。その便の行き先と運行表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待ち合わせ変更後に便の行き先と運行を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sabi ng kaibigan maaari nang alas-diyes y medya. Titingnan ko ang destinasyon at takbo ng biyaheng iyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pagkatapos baguhin ang pagkikita, tingnan ang destinasyon at takbo. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今回は港駅への到着を基準に、券と列車をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Batay sa dating sa Port Station ang gabay sa tiket at tren.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほど別の窓口でもお申し込みされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Nag-apply rin sa ibang counter kanina?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。担当が分からず、同じ住まいの相談を二つの窓口に書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ相談を二窓口に申し込んだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Hindi ko alam ang namamahala, kaya isinulat ang parehong usaping pabahay sa dalawang counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing nag-apply sa dalawa para sa parehong konsultasyon. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二つは別の相談ですか。それとも同じ状況の説明でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Magkaibang usapin o paliwanag ng parehong sitwasyon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じです。二回申し込めば早くなると思ったわけではなく、どちらかが担当かと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別件ではなく担当不明で重複したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pareho. Hindi ko inisip na mapapabilis sa dalawa, kundi baka isa ang namamahala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na nadoble dahil hindi alam ang namamahala, hindi magkaibang usapin. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。申込内容を確認し、必要な担当への引き継ぎを整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Susuriin ang aplikasyon at aayusin ang paglipat sa kailangang kawani.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。片方だけ違う住所を書いてしまったので、正しい住所も同時に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一方の住所の誤りも訂正したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakiusap. Sa isa maling address ang naisulat ko, kaya gusto ko ring ibigay ang tama.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hilinging itama rin ang address ng isang aplikasyon. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訂正する住所はどちらの控えか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Alam kung aling kopya ang may address na itatama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青い控えの方です。もう一方は正しいです。自分で片方を捨てず、二枚とも見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えを区別し両方残して提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ang asul. Tama ang isa. Hindi ko itatapon ang isa, ipapakita ang dalawa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang kopya at panatilihin ang dalawa para ipakita. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。担当者が重複と訂正を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Salamat. Titingnan ng kawani ang pagdodoble at pagwawasto at gagabayan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。同じ相談だと説明し、担当と申込みの扱いが分かるまで新たに申し込みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 重複整理まで新規申込みを増やさないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Sasabihing pareho ang usapin at hindi magdadagdag hanggang malaman ang kawani at pag-asikaso.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang hindi magdagdag hanggang maayos ang nadoble. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二枚の控えをお預かりし、相談の整理担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Tatanggapin ang dalawang kopya at ipapasa sa tagapag-ayos ng konsultasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらは病院までの道の地図でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Mapa ba ito ng daan sa ospital?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 違います。頭が痛くなった場所と時間を書いたメモです。道を聞きたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参メモが道案内ではなく症状の経過だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hindi. Note ng lugar at oras na sumakit ang ulo. Hindi ako nagtatanong ng daan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itama na sintomas ang note, hindi direksiyon. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 症状の経過のメモですね。丸印は場所を表していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Note ng takbo ng sintomas, ano. Lugar ba ang bilog?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、会社と自宅です。ただ、どちらでも同じ痛みかは、うまく言葉にできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 場所の印と説明が難しい範囲を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Opo, trabaho at bahay. Pero mahirap sabihin kung pareho ang sakit sa dalawa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang tanda ng lugar at bahaging mahirap ipaliwanag. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 無理に同じとまとめず、分かる範囲で担当者に説明しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Huwag piliting pagsamahing pareho; ipaliwanag ayon sa alam sa namamahala ng pagpapagamot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社では午後、自宅では夜に気づきました。原因が場所にあるとは言い切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 場所と時間を述べ原因を断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Napansin ko sa trabaho sa hapon, sa bahay sa gabi. Hindi ko masasabing lugar ang sanhi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang lugar at oras nang hindi tinitiyak ang sanhi. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その時刻と場所の情報を伝えます。メモを診療担当者へ見せてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipapasa ang oras at lugar. Maaari bang ipakita sa clinician ang note?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。私の説明を助ける物として見せてください。地図だけで診断を決めてもらうつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: メモを本人説明の補助として診療担当者へ見せてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Bilang tulong sa paliwanag ko, hindi para magpasya ng diagnosis sa mapa lang.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hilinging ipakita sa clinician bilang tulong sa sariling paliwanag. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。メモにない変化も、担当者の質問に答えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Sagutin din ang tanong tungkol sa pagbabagong wala sa note.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。分からない所は分からないと伝え、このメモと一緒に自分で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明点を推測せずメモと自分の説明を併用する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Kung hindi alam, sasabihin, at ipapaliwanag ko kasama ng note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag hulaan ang hindi alam, gamitin ang note at sariling paliwanag. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、症状の経過を補うメモとして、診療担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Opo. Ipapasa bilang note na pandagdag sa takbo ng sintomas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 以前、オンラインでご相談されましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、この画面を開いて内容を打ったので、もう届け出たと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入力画面を見せ受付済みだと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Binuksan ito at itinipa ang nilalaman, kaya akala ko naihain na.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang input screen at sabihing inakalang natanggap. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 送信後の受付番号や完了の表示は確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tiningnan ang reception number o completion display pagkatapos ipadala?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: していません。下書きの画面が残っていて、送信ボタンも押したか覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 完了表示がなく送信操作も不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi. May draft screen pa at hindi ko tanda kung napindot ang send.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang completion display at hindi tiyak ang pag-send. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 閲覧や入力だけと、正式に受け付けられたことは別です。今回の内容を担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Iba ang pagtingin o pag-type lang sa opisyal na pagtanggap. Susuriin ng kawani.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。二重に届けたのか、まだ届いていないのか分からないことも伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二重受付か未受付か分からないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakiusap. Sasabihin ko ring hindi alam kung nadoble o hindi pa natanggap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Kumonsulta na hindi alam kung doble o wala pang pagtanggap. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。画面のサイト名と、入力した時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Opo. Alam ang site name at oras ng pag-type?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: サイト名はここにあります。昨夜の九時ごろです。今ここで勝手に再送信せず、画面を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: サイト名と入力時刻を示し再送を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Narito ang site name. Mga alas-nuwebe kagabi. Hindi ako basta magre-resend dito, ipapakita ko ang screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ibigay site at oras at ipagpaliban ang resend. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。受付の扱いと相談方法を担当者へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Tiyakin natin ang pagtanggap at konsultasyon sa kawani.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。下書きを残したまま、既存の受付記録と今回の相談を整理してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 下書きを残し受付記録の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Iiwan ang draft at ipapaayos ang dating tala at kasalukuyang konsultasyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Panatilihin ang draft at hilinging suriin ang acceptance records. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。オンラインの受付未確認として担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Opo. Ipapasa bilang hindi pa tiyak na online acceptance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その番号は、配送の番号でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買った時の番号です。注文が確定したので、これで郵便の状況も分かると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 注文番号で配送状況を見られると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Numero noong bumili. Kumpirmado ang order kaya akala ko makikita rin ang koreo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na inakalang makikita ang delivery sa order number. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注文番号と郵便の追跡番号は別です。発送の連絡は届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Iba ang order number at postal tracking number. Dumating ang dispatch notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「注文受付」の連絡だけです。「発送」の連絡があるかはまだ見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発送連絡をまだ確認していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Order received lang. Hindi ko pa tiningnan kung may dispatched na mensahe.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi pa tiningnan ang dispatch notice. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 販売元の発送案内から、配送会社と番号を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tingnan ang carrier at numero sa shipping notice ng seller.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。郵便で送られたと決めず、メールと注文画面を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配送会社も含め発送案内を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Titingnan ko email at order screen nang hindi ipinapalagay na postal ang padala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tingnan ang dispatch notice kasama ang carrier. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 販売元の確認が必要な場合もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Minsan kailangan ding magtanong sa seller.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: メールにはまだ準備中とあります。配送番号がないので、販売元へ発送予定を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 準備中と分かり販売元へ予定を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Preparing pa raw ang email. Walang shipping number, kaya tatanungin ko ang seller ng planong dispatch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Malaman na preparing at tanungin seller ng plano. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにしてください。ここで未発送の注文の状況を確定することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Gawin iyon. Hindi matitiyak dito ang hindi pa naipadalang order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。注文の受付と発送を分け、配送会社と番号が分かってから必要な照会をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 注文受付と発送を区別し適切な番号で照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Ihihiwalay order acceptance at dispatch, saka magtatanong kung alam na carrier at numero.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay order acceptance at dispatch at gamitin ang tamang numero. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本日は注文元への確認をご案内し、配達照会は進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Ngayon seller muna ang ituturo, hindi magpapatuloy sa delivery inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入金額はこちらの五千円ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Limang libong yen ang deposito rito, ano?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 数えた時は五千円でしたが、ここへ来る前に交通費を取り分けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 集計後に交通費を抜いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Limang libo noong binilang, pero bago pumunta ibinukod ko ang pamasahe.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na nagbawas ng pamasahe matapos bilangin. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それでは今お預けになる金額は違うかもしれません。取り分けた額は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Baka iba na ang idedeposito. Alam ang ibinukod na halaga?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三百円のつもりでしたが、急いだので確かではありません。差し引きだけで決めたくないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 取り分け額が不確かで単純計算を避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Balak tatlong daan, pero nagmadali kaya hindi tiyak. Ayokong ibatay sa pagbabawas lang.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi tiyak ang ibinukod at ayaw ng simpleng kalkulasyon. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在お持ちの入金分を確認しましょう。取り分けた財布とは分かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tingnan ang pangdeposito ngayon. Hiwalay sa wallet ng pamasahe?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、入金分はこの袋、交通費は財布です。財布のお金まで混ぜないで確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入金袋と財布を分け確認対象を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. Dito sa bag ang deposito, sa wallet ang pamasahe. Ayokong isama ang pera ng wallet sa pagsusuri.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang deposit bag at wallet at tukuyin ang susuriin. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。袋の中の金額を確認し、申込額の訂正方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Bibilangin ang bag at ituturo ang pagwasto ng halaga.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。元の集計表は消さず、取り分けた後に金額を変えたことを記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元の集計を残し金額変更の経緯を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakiusap. Hindi ko buburahin ang unang tally, itatala na nabago matapos magbukod.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Panatilihin ang unang tally at itala ang dahilan ng pagbabago. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。現在の金額が確定してから入金の意思を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo. Kapag tiyak ang kasalukuyang halaga, tatanungin ang kagustuhang magdeposito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。元の五千円ではなく、袋にある確認済みの額を預けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現物確認後の金額で入金すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Ang natiyak na laman ng bag, hindi unang limang libo, ang idedeposito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang ideposito ang halagang natiyak sa aktuwal na pera. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず入金用の袋だけを確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Una, bag na pangdeposito lang ang susuriin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品をお探しでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ito ba ang hinahanap na produkto?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっき試食しておいしかったので、この箱を選びました。同じ物ですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試食の品と取った箱が同じか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Masarap ang tinikman kanina kaya ito ang pinili. Pareho, ano?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tiyaking pareho ang sample at napiling kahon. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 試食はしょうゆ味、こちらの箱は塩味です。近くにありますが別の商品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Toyo ang sample, asin ang kahon. Malapit pero ibang produkto.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ色の箱だったので迷いました。試食した味の名前を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見た目で選んだことを説明し味の名前を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pareho ang kulay ng kahon kaya nalito. Sabihin ang pangalan ng tinikmang lasa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na sa hitsura pumili at itanong ang pangalan ng lasa. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 「しょうゆせんべい」です。こちらの札に商品名があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Soy sauce rice crackers. Nasa karatulang ito ang pangalan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。しょうゆ味の箱に替えたいです。今の箱はまだ会計していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未会計の商品を試食した味へ交換したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Salamat. Gusto kong palitan ng toyo. Hindi ko pa binabayaran ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hilinging palitan ang hindi bayad ng tinikmang lasa. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。スタッフが元の場所へ戻します。こちらがしょうゆ味です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Ibabalik ng staff sa dati. Ito ang toyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: これですね。詰め合わせではなく、全部しょうゆ味かも表示で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 単一味か詰め合わせか内容表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ito, ano? Gusto kong tingnan kung puro toyo, hindi assortment, sa label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tingnan kung isang lasa o halo ang laman. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この箱はしょうゆ味だけです。表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Toyo lang ang kahon. Tingnan ang label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できました。試食の印象だけでなく、名前と内容を見てこちらを買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品名と内容を確認して購入を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Natiyak ko na. Titingnan ko pangalan at laman, hindi impresyon sa sample lang, at ito ang bibilhin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang pangalan at laman bago bumili. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。しょうゆ味の箱一つで会計いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Isang kahon ng toyo ang sisingilin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベンチについてご質問ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 人の名前が書いてあるので、その人の予約席だと思いました。座らない方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 名札を予約席だと思い利用可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: May pangalan ng tao kaya akala ko reserved niya. Mas mabuting huwag umupo?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing inakalang nameplate ay reservation at itanong ang paggamit. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面では、寄贈者を示す札です。予約席の表示ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sa sitwasyong ito, pangalan ng donor ang plaka, hindi reservation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 寄贈した人の名前なんですね。名前があることと、今日の利用者が決まっていることは別でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 寄贈者名と当日の予約表示を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Donor pala. Iba ang may pangalan at may nakatakdang gagamit ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay donor name at reservation ngayong araw. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。一般のベンチとして使えますが、ほかの利用者とも譲り合ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Opo. Pampublikong bangko pero magbigayan sa iba.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。荷物を横に並べて一人で全部使わず、空きを残して座ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物で全体を占有しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Hindi ko ilalatag ang bag para sakupin lahat, mag-iiwan ng puwang.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi sasakupin lahat sa gamit. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お願いします。利用中の人がいれば、その場で声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Pakiusap. Kung may gumagamit, tanungin doon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は一人座っています。隣が空いているか聞いてから、座ろうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 既存の利用者に空席を確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: May isang nakaupo. Itatanong ko kung bakante ang katabi bago umupo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang tiyakin sa gumagamit ang bakante. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。札を外したり隠したりする必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo. Hindi kailangang alisin o takpan ang plaka.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。名札はそのままにして、先に座っている人と相談して使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札を変えず利用者と相談して使う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Iiwan ang nameplate at kausapin ang nauna para gamitin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag baguhin ang plaka at makipag-usap sa gumagamit. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。一般のベンチとして、譲り合ってご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Magbigayan sa pampublikong bangko.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの乗り換えをご利用ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この案内です。徒歩七分とありますが、改札の中を歩くんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 徒歩区間が駅構内か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Gabay na ito. Pitong minutong lakad, sa loob ba ng ticket gates?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung lakad sa loob ng istasyon. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面では別の駅まで外を歩く区間です。同じ駅のホーム移動ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sa sitwasyong ito, lakad sa labas patungong ibang istasyon, hindi plataporma sa parehong istasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外へ出るんですね。今の券で改札を出て、次の駅でもそのまま使えるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別駅への移動と現在の券の扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Lalabas pala. Gusto kong tiyakin kung puwedeng lumabas sa tiket ngayon at gamitin pa sa susunod na istasyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang paglipat sa ibang istasyon at tiket ngayon. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券の区間と種類を係員が確認します。地図だけでは券の扱いは決まりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titingnan ng kawani ang saklaw at uri. Hindi mapa lang ang batayan ng tiket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。券を見せます。外の道は、この案内の点線の部分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 券を提示し徒歩経路を地図で特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Ipapakita ang tiket. Ang dotted part ba ang daan sa labas?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang tiket at tukuyin ang lakad sa mapa. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。歩行者用の経路をご案内します。線路沿いに近道できるとは考えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Opo. Ituturo ang pedestrian route. Huwag isiping puwedeng shortcut sa tabi ng riles.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 雨が強いので、歩く経路を確認してから友人に合流が遅れるか伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 天候による時間変化を友人へ伝える予定を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Malakas ang ulan, kaya pagkatukoy sa daan sasabihin ko sa kaibigan kung mahuhuli.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang planong ipaalam ang pagbabago ng oras dahil sa panahon. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 券の確認後、外の移動が難しければ別経路も相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pagkatapos ng tiket, kung mahirap sa labas maaaring ikonsulta ang ibang ruta.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。まず券の扱いと徒歩の道を聞き、移動方法を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券と経路を確認後に移動方法を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap. Una tiket at daang lakad, saka pipili ng paraan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pumili ng paglalakbay matapos tiyakin tiket at ruta. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。券の確認担当へご案内し、徒歩の経路図もお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Ituturo sa ticket staff at bibigyan din ng walking route map.
